description: List real companies that used AI and how it turned out: measured result, company-reported result, went wrong, or partly walked back. Use it for 'Who has done this?' or 'What went wrong for others?'. Filter by the kind of work AI was used for (task), outcome, theme, industry or company size; returns the cases in one line each, or a menu with counts when there are many. Fetch the ones you use with get_evidence for the story, who produced the figures and the public sources.

industry.description: Cases in this industry: professional-services, agencies, ecommerce-retail, manufacturing, or other (none of the four, e.g. banks, airlines, public bodies). Practices apply to all industries.

outcome.description: Cases with this outcome: measured, company-reported, went-wrong or walked-back.

size.description: Company size band: micro-small, medium, mid-market, enterprise (1–49, 50–249, 250–999, 1,000+ employees). Or pass employees instead.

task.description: The kind of work AI was used for: a task key from start, e.g. customer-service-and-support.

theme.description: A theme key from start, e.g. governance-and-risk or people-and-skills.

name: find_company_cases
title: Find company cases of AI use
